gaps.lead: The painter worked for three weeks on the mural.
gaps.explanation: spend + time + -ing: spent over three weeks (working on it).

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: Action starting in the past and continuing: has been working (present perfect continuous).

gaps.lead: The committee is unlikely to change the rules.
gaps.sentence: ___ that the committee will change the rules.
gaps.explanation: Impersonal it: It is unlikely that…

gaps.lead: 'I broke the window,' said the boy.
gaps.explanation: admit + -ing (optionally 'to'): admitted breaking / admitted to breaking.

gaps.lead: 'You mustn't run near the pool,' the lifeguard told the children.
gaps.sentence: The lifeguard told the children ___ near the pool.

gaps.lead: I want to go somewhere where nobody knows me.
gaps.sentence: I want to go ___ nobody knows me.
